meta.pattern_note: 유강중 기출 없음 — 공립중 표준형(객관식 22 + 서술형 4)으로 설계
review_notes: ① 창작 문항(1·2·3·4·5·9·14·15·20·22·23·24·25·26): 영어 자연스러움과 정답 유일성 — 기출이 없어 전부 창작임
② 교과서 대화·본문 변형(6·7·8·10~13·16~19·21): 바꾼 부분(빈칸·삽입 문장·무관 문장)만 원문과 대조
④ 교차 힌트: 기준 (a) — 출제 문항끼리·지문→문항 모두 차단. 잔여(무해): #6·#7이 교과서 표현 be going to / Have a nice trip을 공유
⑤ ⚠ 유강중 기출 원본이 없어 문항 수·배점·서술형 비중은 공립중 표준형 가정 — 1학기 시험지를 구하면 그 틀로 재조정 필요

questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 알맞지 않은 것은? [3점]

questions.question:
다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 단어의 뜻풀이로 관련이 없는 것은? [4점] (단, 빈칸에 들어가는 순서는 상관없음.)
· Don't forget your ________ when you travel abroad.
· I bought a small ________ for my friend at the shop.
· We made a ________ for our three-day trip.
· The ________ showed us around the old town.
· My ________ was too heavy to carry.
choices: ① a person or book that gives information to travelers
② a person who takes care of the paintings in a museum
③ a plan that shows the times of the things you will do
④ an official document that you need to enter another country
⑤ the bags that you take with you when you travel
questions.explanation: 빈칸: passport·souvenir·schedule·guide·luggage. ②는 curator의 뜻으로 빈칸에 없음(souvenir는 풀이 없음).  [출처: 일반 어휘(여행 소재)]

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것은? [3점]
choices: ① There is not any chairs in the room.
② Is there some apples on the table?
③ Are there a library near here?
④ Were there many students in the hall?
⑤ There isn't many cars on the street.
questions.explanation: ① are not ② Are there any ③ Is there ⑤ aren't. ④ 복수 주어 + Were there ~?  [출처: 천재(이상기) L5 문법포인트 There+be동사+주어]

② Look at the <u>sleeping</u> cat on the sofa.
③ <u>Riding</u> a bike is good exercise.
④ She is good at <u>drawing</u> animals.

questions.question:

questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은? [3점]
Alex: Hi, Kate. What are you going to do this weekend?
Kate: I'm going to visit Jeju-do with my family.
Junho: Oh, my grandparents live there. Jeju-do is so beautiful.
Kate: Really? This is my first trip to Jeju-do. I'm so excited.
Alex: What are you going to do there?
Kate: I'm going to see dolphins. I'll also hike Hallasan.
Junho: You should visit a horse park and ride a horse, too. It's really fun.
Kate: That's a good idea. I'll visit there, too.
Junho: Jeju-do is an amazing place. Have a nice trip!
choices: ① Kate는 제주도에 여러 번 가 보았다.
② Junho의 조부모님은 제주도에 사신다.
③ Kate는 한라산에 가지 않을 것이다.
④ Alex는 승마 공원을 추천했다.
⑤ Kate는 돌고래를 보지 않을 것이다.
questions.explanation: ① 첫 여행 ③ hike Hallasan ④ 추천한 사람은 Junho ⑤ see dolphins.  [출처: 천재(이상기) L5 대화 Watch and Do]
questions.source: 천재(이상기) L5 대화 Watch and Do

questions.question:

<Tongyeong Walking Tour>
· When: Saturday, October 10, 10 a.m.
· Where: Meet at Jungang Market
· What: Walk along the seaside and visit Dongpirang
· Cost: 5,000 won for students / 8,000 won for adults
<Night Market Festival>
· When: Every Friday in October, 6 p.m. - 10 p.m.
· Where: Gangguan Square
· Food: Chungmu gimbap, fried squid, and honey bread
· Note: There is no parking lot. Please take a bus.
choices: ① The walking tour starts at Dongpirang.
② Students pay 8,000 won for the walking tour.
③ The night market opens every Saturday.
④ You can eat Chungmu gimbap at the night market.
⑤ You can park your car at Gangguan Square.
questions.explanation: ① 모이는 곳은 중앙시장 ② 학생 5,000원 ③ 매주 금요일 ⑤ 주차장 없음.  [출처: L5 소재 기반 창작 안내문]

questions.question:
다음 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은? [3점]
August 16th
I got up at six in the morning. It was the first day of my family trip to Tongyeong. I was ⓐ________!
( ① ) We arrived at Jungang Market at 1 p.m. ( ② ) There we had Chungmu gimbap for lunch. There was only rice inside the roll! ( ③ ) Dad said, "Try the roll with radish and squid. Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea." ( ④ ) It was a bit ⓑ________ but tasty. ( ⑤ )
In the afternoon, we went to Yi Sun-sin Park. There was a huge statue of Admiral Yi. I imagined the great battle right off the coast of Tongyeong. Then we enjoyed taking a walk along the coast. The sunset was beautiful. I closed my eyes. I could feel Admiral Yi's love for the country. Everything was really ⓒ________.
August 17th
Early in the morning, we went to Dongpirang. There were many pretty paintings on the walls. It was the best place for taking pictures! Mom and I took hundreds of pictures. Finally, my dad said, "Please stop! No more pictures!"
* 'Dong' means 'east,' and 'pirang' means 'cliff.'
Next, we went to the Jeon Hyuck-lim Museum of Art. The painter's nickname is 'The Magician of Color.' He painted the sea of Tongyeong with various blue colors. I enjoyed his paintings very much.
choices: ① Chungmu gimbap has only rice inside the roll.
② Long ago, fishermen ate Chungmu gimbap out at sea.
③ The family saw a huge statue of Admiral Yi.
④ The writer took only a few pictures at Dongpirang.
⑤ The painter's nickname is 'The Magician of Color.'
questions.explanation: ④ hundreds of pictures — 조금만 찍은 것이 아님.  [출처: 천재(이상기) L5 본문]

questions.question:
위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? [3점]
Junho: Look at this exhibition poster. ( ⓐ )
Minji: I think it's beautiful.
Alex: It's The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh, right?
Junho: Right. I like this painting. The colors of the night sky are amazing.
Alex: I think so, too.
Junho: Look! The van Gogh exhibition is going on at Mirae Museum. How about going there together?
Alex: That's a great idea! I want to see van Gogh's paintings.
Minji: We can also learn about his life and art in the exhibition.
Junho: When can we go? It ends on October 1st.
Alex: Let's go there this Saturday then.
Minji: That sounds great.

② I don't think so.
③ That sounds great.
④ Have a nice trip!
⑤ What do you think about this painting?
questions.explanation: 뒤에서 "I think it's beautiful."로 의견을 말하므로 의견을 묻는 표현이 와야 함.  [출처: 천재(이상기) L6 대화 Watch and Do]

questions.question:
다음 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은? [4점]
Hello, everyone. My name is Amélie. Welcome to my husband's gallery. Look at me. ① <u>Do you think that I'm strange?</u> ② <u>My husband, Henri Matisse, colored my face in green.</u> ③ <u>My face isn't actually green.</u> ④ <u>He wanted to express his emotions with bright and wild colors.</u> ⑤ <u>Green is the most popular color for cars in Europe.</u> People didn't like this painting style at first. Some people thought that a beast painted me. So, he got the nickname Wild Beast. He kept his own style and finally became famous.
Hi, there. Can you find ⓐ <u>me</u> in the picture? Actually, ⓑ <u>I</u>'m an animal. Start from the green shape in the middle. Then trace the other shapes with your finger. ⓒ <u>They</u> look like a snail shell. Yes, ⓓ <u>I</u>'m a snail! Matisse created ⓔ <u>me</u> in a unique way. He painted paper and cut out shapes with scissors. Then he put the shapes together and made me. At the age of 70, Matisse got very sick. However, he never gave up art. He created a new art form. It's cut-outs. Do you want to find more artworks like me? Look around the gallery and explore Henri Matisse's world of art!
choices: ① Matisse painted his wife's face in green.
② Amélie's face was really green.
③ Matisse created the snail with paint only.
④ Matisse stopped making art at the age of 70.
⑤ The snail shapes start from a blue shape in the middle.
questions.explanation: ② 실제로 초록색은 아님 ③ 종이를 칠해 가위로 오려 붙임 ④ 포기하지 않음 ⑤ 가운데 초록색 도형.  [출처: 천재(이상기) L6 본문]

questions.question:
괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오. [6점]
(1) Matisse never gave up (create) ________ new art.
